utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Monday, second of November. Can you all hear me, or am I doing the Teams mime again?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, you're there. Unlike the heating in the portakabin. I'm sat here in my coat.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: That's the winter office package. Coat stays on till April.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Lovely. Not putting a job in through this meeting, by the way, just having a moan.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Could be worse. You could've sat through the football last night like I did.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: I switched it off. Had enough disappointment for one Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Sensible. Ninety minutes I'm not getting back.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes a sports podcast. What's already finished?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah so, tested the Palletiser yesterday and it's all fine now.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: That's the completed one, yeah? Not another test on today's list?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Correct. Done, tested, fine. Nothing new off that.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And finished the repair on the Line 3 Chiller last night. That repair's done as well.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Just on that—sorry, talking over you—the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the Line 3 Chiller.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, separate status points. Repair finished, delivery confirmation still blocked. Not adding a supplier chase today.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Exactly. It's an outstanding blocker, not me taking a new action.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: One other observation: saw the pressure on the Main Outfeed Conveyor dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, observation only. No new job being agreed off that here.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Hannah Price, can you write up the near miss at the line 2 guard? Monday, so today, and that one's safety critical, straight away.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yes, I'll write up the near miss at the line 2 guard straight away. Monday, today, understood.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, that needs to stay distinct from the routine bits. Safety-critical write-up.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Agreed. That's the write-up I'm accepting, not rolling some other job into it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. Straight away, with today's Monday deadline.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yep, clear. Sorry, there's a bit of an echo my end.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Next, the risk assessment for work on the gas turbine one needs updating for tomorrow morning. Not an emergency but don't let it slip. Anyone able to take that?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Um, I can't take ownership of that one. Don't put it against me just because it's a risk assessment.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: I'm not picking that up either.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Nor me, I'm afraid.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. It still needs doing for tomorrow morning, but nobody's taken it. That stays explicitly unowned.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, and no implied yes from me. I'm not accepting it.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Understood. Tomorrow morning is still the requirement; we're not saying it's gone away.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Correct. Needed, not an emergency but don't let it slip, and no owner agreed.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Dave, can you inspect the relief valve for leaks by Wednesday?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Just the inspection for leaks on the relief valve, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, that's the job. By Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yep, I'll inspect the relief valve for leaks by Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Inspection, not a repair being promised on this call. Got you.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Exactly. Let's not make the sentence bigger while I'm saying yes to it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Aisha Begum, can you recalibrate the sensors on the GT2 Inlet Water Injection Valve by the end of the week, if you've got a spare minute?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, so that's a fit-it-in one, not everything down right now?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's right. If you've got a spare minute, with by the end of the week still the deadline.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Okay, I'll recalibrate the sensors on the GT2 Inlet Water Injection Valve by the end of the week. I'll fit that in.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: A spare minute. Rare bit of equipment, that.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Usually missing from the toolbox, yeah.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Davey, can you do a site visit at Harbour Road Warehouse with the contractor by the 28th? Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: A visit there with the contractor, completed by the 28th, rather than just something in the diary?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, do the site visit at Harbour Road Warehouse with the contractor by the 28th. Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Understood. I'll do the site visit at Harbour Road Warehouse with the contractor by the 28th.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Different nickname for each job. Keeps you on your toes.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Still only one pair of boots, unfortunately.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And Hannah, can you book a contractor to look at the main water valve by the 28th? No rush.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yep—just to separate those two, mine's the booking by the 28th, not saying the contractor has to have visited by then?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Correct. Book a contractor to look at the main water valve by the 28th. No rush on that one.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Okay, I'll book a contractor to look at the main water valve by the 28th. Understood, no rush.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: That distinction helps. Easy to hear the same date twice and mash the two together.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, separate jobs, separate agreements. That's the list.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And my bits were completed work and that pressure observation. Nothing extra accepted on my side.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Same distinction on the Line 3 Chiller delivery. Still blocked on the supplier confirmation, not a new chase.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Only ownership gap is updating the risk assessment for work on the gas turbine one. Tomorrow morning, not an emergency but don't let it slip. Nobody has taken it.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yes, that's accurate. Mentioning it hasn't made me the owner.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. No names being slipped into empty boxes. Everything else is accepted as discussed.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: A meeting with no mystery jobs at the end. We're improving.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Don't sound so surprised. Right, thanks everyone.
